comment: hack.c domove_swap_with_pet() swaps a levitating hero with a pet standing on lava, and domove_core() finishes the arrival on the lava square. A Priest in debug mode puts on a wished ring of levitation, wishes for lava under itself, and creates a tame gas spore (a floater, so goodpos() lets it onto lava). The first step swaps the spore onto the lava; the step back swaps the hero onto it.
